description: Searches the descriptions in the current Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (USITC) for product words and returns matching 8- and 10-digit HTS lines with code, description, parent headings, general (column 1) duty rate and unit of quantity. Some everyday terms (for example laptop, drone, e-bike) are mapped to HTS wording, and the mapping is shown in the result.

include_chapter_99.description: Also return Chapter 99 lines (additional duties and temporary provisions). Default false.

keyword.description: Product words, e.g. "copper wire", "lithium-ion batteries", "cotton t-shirts".

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return, 1 to 25 (default 10).

name: hts_search
title: Search the U.S. tariff schedule (HTS)
